paragraphs: The Evoque TD4 was fitted to the first-generation L538 Range Rover Evoque from 2011 to 2016. It uses the Ford Duratorq — a 2.0-litre turbocharged diesel that was shared across a range of Ford and Land Rover vehicles of that era. From 2016 onwards, the Evoque switched to the Ingenium diesel family (D150/D165/D180), a different engine platform entirely. The Ford Duratorq in the Evoque TD4 is known for injector seal leaks and EGR clogging as the mileage builds — a well-established pattern among Ford and Land Rover specialists. The Evoque TD4 was discontinued after the 2016 model year when the L551 generation introduced the Ingenium range, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ford Duratorq engines for every Evoque TD4 on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre diesel fitted to the Evoque TD4 from 2011 to 2016, across the L538 generation. Known for injector seal leaks and EGR clogging over time — see the callout above. We replace worn injector seals, clean or replace the EGR, and replace gaskets as standard on every Ford Duratorq rebuild.
